stage.name: At the End, Peace and Quiet Is Found
stage.description:
History is just our collective impression of the past. It takes more specific planning to live in the present.
<Decrystallizing Totem> Removes all Crystal in a line.
Condition: DP Cost does not recover naturally. Gain 3 DP for every Crystal removed.

event.name: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun

content.label: AS
content.name: Adventure That Cannot Wait for the Sun

street_bandit.name: Street Bandit
street_bandit.flavourText: Bandits often found in Sargonian cities. Equipped with basic gear, they attack only if necessary.
abilities: Movement Speed significantly increases when on Crystal.

roaming_street_bandit.name: Roaming Street Bandit
roaming_street_bandit.flavourText: Bandits that roam many Sargonian cities. They are experienced fighters who have survived many run-ins.
abilities: Movement Speed significantly increases when on Crystal.

exhibit_237_2.name: Exhibit 237-2
exhibit_237_2.flavourText: A curious jewel construct that was believed to be a crane. Now it drags a gem around.
abilities: Places Crystal on the first tile without Crystal to significantly increase its Movement Speed.

gliding_crown.name: 'Gliding Crown'
gliding_crown.flavourText: A jewel construct that can fly. 'The books said it was a crown! Who put so many gems on it?'
abilities: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Drops Crystal on tiles it passes over, losing a percentage of HP with each drop.

exhibit_237_1.name: Exhibit 237-1
exhibit_237_1.flavourText: A curious jewel construct that was believed to be a water pump. Now it runs around with a gem in its...'hand.'
abilities: Places Crystal on the first tile without Crystal to significantly increase its Movement Speed.

street_hunter.name: Street Hunter
street_hunter.flavourText: Hunters often seen in Sargonian towns. Their bows are used for hunting in the wilderness, as well as for 'solving problems.'

roaming_street_hunter.name: Roaming Street Hunter
roaming_street_hunter.flavourText: Hunters often found roaming between Sargonian cities. Hunters who excel at 'solving problems' naturally find their services in great demand across cities.

gliding_toy.name: 'Gliding Toy'
gliding_toy.flavourText: A jewel construct that can fly. 'The books said it was a toy! Hey, why is it leaking gems?'
abilities: Flying unit.
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter
Drops Crystal on tiles it passes over, losing a percentage of HP with each drop.

small_bejeweled_wagon.name: Small Bejeweled Wagon
small_bejeweled_wagon.flavourText: A wheeled jewel construct that was once an immobile exhibit. Now it roams the streets, filled with gems.
abilities: Drops Crystal on tiles that it passes through.
Upon taking damage, Movement Speed significantly increases for a period of time.

hall_statue_right.name: Hall Statue (Right)
hall_statue_right.flavourText: A jewel construct with hands that glow with radiance. The statue on the right side of the hall now roams the streets, a testament to the destructive power of ancient technology.
abilities: Attacks inflict Arts Damage over a short period (stacks).
ASPD is significantly increased when on Crystal.

bouncing_unicycle.name: 'Bouncing Unicycle'
bouncing_unicycle.flavourText: A single-wheel jewel construct. Its upper structure once bewildered researchers, but those who have seen its head bounce no longer harbor any doubts.
abilities: Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Has a short default attack range, but performs extremely long-range attacks when on Crystal.

angry_rampage.name: 'Angry Rampage'
angry_rampage.flavourText: A jewel construct with punches that match its kicks. 'I'm going to bless you before I kick you.'
abilities: Absorbs power from surrounding Crystals to provide Barriers for nearby enemies.

angry_stampede.name: 'Angry Stampede'
angry_stampede.flavourText: A jewel construct with kicks worse than its punches. 'I'm going to kick you.'
abilities: Absorbs power from surrounding Crystals to provide Barriers for nearby enemies.

bejeweled_slab_guardian.name: 'Bejeweled Slab Guardian'
bejeweled_slab_guardian.flavourText: Strange entities sighted amongst the jewel constructs. The bejeweled stone slabs that they carry shine brightly in the night streets, like glowing great swords.
abilities: More likely to be attacked
Starts with low DEF and RES, but permanently gains DEF when taking Physical damage and RES when taking Arts damage, up to a maximum.

unicycle_toy.name: 'Unicycle Toy'
unicycle_toy.flavourText: A single-wheel jewel construct, believed to be a children's toy when it sat docilely on its stand.
abilities: Attacks two targets simultaneously.
Has a short default attack range, but performs extremely long-range attacks when on Crystal.
